findings.evidence: Multiple empty heading tags found in the outline (e.g., H3 with no text, empty H6 elements).
findings.context: Empty headings can negatively impact assistive technologies and screen reader navigation.
findings.impact: Users relying on screen readers may experience confusing navigation or skipped sections.
findings.recommendation: Remove empty heading elements or populate them with appropriate text.

ai_analysis.page_purpose: Present interactive television subscription plans, offers, and compatible smart TVs with a contract from Yettel.
ai_analysis.target_audience: Residential customers in Bulgaria looking for home interactive television and TV-internet bundle services.
ai_analysis.intended_action: Select and order a Yettel TV plan with a contract or choose a recommended smart TV.
ai_analysis.summary: The page provides options for interactive television plans, displaying promotional banners for Xiaomi smart TVs and detailing available subscription tiers. Content quality is generally clear, though minor structural nesting issues exist in headings.
